instruction: Describe the visible condition of this tomato leaf.
caption: This tomato leaf is affected by early blight, showing brown-to-dark-brown circular lesions with concentric rings (target/bull's-eye), with pronounced yellow halos and general leaflet yellowing.
diagnosis: This tomato leaf is consistent with **Early Blight** (Early blight).
symptoms: target/bull's-eye concentric rings with yellow halo on older leaves
